description: Reviewed pin for the cloudflared Windows x64 executable that PaRuX downloads when the person chooses Install with PaRuX for the opt-in Internet tunnel. Source: official release on github.com/cloudflare/cloudflared. To bump: download the asset, compute SHA-256, compare with the digest GitHub shows for the release asset (gh api repos/cloudflare/cloudflared/releases/tags/<tag>), update this file AND src/PaRuX.Server/Tunnel/CloudflaredPin.cs in one reviewed commit (a unit test fails when they disagree).
